test_file_filter.verdict_paper_era: 63b9d44 eval/sandbox.py _filter_test_files, so both verdicts judge the same merges; 59bbf65 kept only code files (core/patch.py _filter_patch), see dropped_by_filter

rules.verdict_63b9d44: eval.json both_passed, from CooperBench's test_merged: the naive merge's tests when it is clean, else agent1's patch alone against both suites
rules.verdict_paper_era: naive merge, then union when naive conflicts, then the learned resolver when union fails a suite (59bbf65 run_merge_evaluation); no agent1-alone fallback; 63b9d44's pass rule
rules.verdict_paper_era_regex: the same cascade under 59bbf65's pass rule
rules.pass_rule: exit code 0 and a parsed passed count above 0 (63b9d44 eval/sandbox.py _run_tests)
rules.pass_rule_regex: 59bbf65 evaluation/test_runner.py _parse_test_output: a pass word and no failure word, exit code ignored
rules.patch_apply: 63b9d44 _setup_branches: git apply, then git apply --3way; 59bbf65 used git apply --whitespace=fix and stopped the evaluation when a patch failed
rules.conflict_size: 59bbf65 core/merge.py _analyze_diff_content over the conflicted merge's git diff; conflict_score 20 per section and 2 per line; severity by reporter.py _get_severity_level
rules.llm: 59bbf65 evaluation/llm_merge.py: its system prompt, 5 lines of context, temperature 0, 3 retries, its splice; the merge then tested from its own diff
